entries.title: Show HN: ChatGPT UI for rabbit holes
entries.author: maxkrieger
entries.current_title: Show HN: ChatGPT UI for rabbit holes
entries.excerpt: I was inspired by the way ChatGPT writes bullet lists, then invites you to "delve" deeper. This is an interface that reifies that rabbit-holing process into a tiling layout. The model is instructed to output hyperlink-prompts when it mentions something you might want to delve into. Lots of features to add (sessions, sharing, navigation, highlight-to-delve, images, ...). Would love to hear other usecases and ideas!
entries.guide_zh: 把 ChatGPT 的追问展开成平铺界面，沿着话题分支不断深入。
